product.faq1A: Every batch is third-party tested by an ISO 17025-certified lab (Eurofins Biolab, Synlab, or Biolab GmbH). HPLC purity, endotoxin levels, and mass-spec identity are confirmed before the batch is released. You can find the COA PDF for each batch in the Documents tab.
product.faq2Q: What does the Certificate of Analysis include?
product.faq2A: The COA includes HPLC purity %, endotoxin (EU/mg), mass-spec confirmation, batch ID, manufacturing date, expiry, and the testing lab. Each batch has a unique code you can use to look up its specific COA in /coa.
product.faq3Q: How should I store the vial after opening?
product.faq3A: For lyophilized peptides, store at -20 °C in a desiccated environment. After reconstitution, store at 2-8 °C and use within the timeframe indicated by your protocol. Each product's data sheet lists the specific storage temperature.
product.faq4Q: Do you ship to my country?
product.faq4A: We currently ship to all EU member states plus Norway, Switzerland, and the UK. A handful of jurisdictions are restricted by local regulation — see the full list at checkout. Banned countries (per the EU restricted-substances directive) cannot be served.
product.faq5Q: Can I get a VAT refund as a non-EU researcher?
product.faq5A: If you provide a valid non-EU VAT registration or research-institution ID, we'll zero-rate VAT on your order. Email the document to billing@averianlabs.eu after placing your order and we'll refund the VAT line.
product.faq6Q: What payment methods do you accept?
product.faq6A: Stripe (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay), PayPal, SEPA bank transfer for institutional orders over €1000, and Coinbase Commerce for BTC / ETH / USDC. EU consumer protection law applies to every payment method.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how AverianLabs Oy ("we") processes personal data on averianlabs.eu and affiliated domains, in compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Personal Data Act.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: Account data: email, name, hashed password (if you create an account). Order data: shipping/billing address, order history. Technical data: IP (truncated), user agent, referrer (kept 30 days). Analytics: only with your explicit consent via the cookie banner.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful basis
lawfulBasis.body: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) for orders, consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) for analytics, legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) for accounting.

subprocessors.title: Subprocessors
subprocessors.body: Stripe Payments Europe Ltd — payment processing (EU); Coinbase Commerce — crypto payments; Resend — transactional email (EU); PostHog Cloud EU — product analytics (consent-gated); Sanity Inc. — content (US, EU data residency); Cloudflare — CDN / DDoS; Neon — database (Frankfurt).

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object. Email privacy@averianlabs.eu. You may also lodge a complaint with your national supervisory authority (in Finland: tietosuojavaltuutettu).

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account data: until deletion. Order data: 7 years (accounting). Analytics: 14 months.

faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we get most.

items.q: Are your products for human consumption?
items.a: No. All products sold by AverianLabs are intended strictly for laboratory research and in-vitro studies. They are not for human or veterinary use.
We dispatch within 24 hours from our Helsinki warehouse. EU delivery is typically 1–3 business days via Posti or DHL.

items.q: Do you provide Certificates of Analysis?
items.a: Yes. Every batch ships with a batch-specific COA (HPLC purity, mass-spec confirmation) and endotoxin report. PDFs are available publicly at /coa.

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We ship to all EU countries plus UK, NO, CH, and TR. We do not ship to a small number of restricted jurisdictions (see terms).

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cards (Visa, MC, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay, iDEAL, Klarna, SEPA Direct Debit, and crypto (BTC, ETH, USDC) via Coinbase Commerce.

items.q: Do you offer volume / B2B pricing?
items.a: Yes — apply for our partner program. Universities, research labs, and resellers get up to 35% off and NET-14 invoicing.

labTests.title: How we test every batch
labTests.subtitle: Independent verification at every step. No batch ships without a complete analytical fingerprint.

tests.title: HPLC purity
tests.body: Reversed-phase HPLC quantifies peptide content against a certified reference standard. Acceptance: ≥ 98%.

tests.title: Endotoxin (LAL)
tests.body: Kinetic chromogenic LAL per USP <85>. Acceptance: < 5 EU/mg.

tests.title: Mass spectrometry
tests.body: ESI-MS confirms molecular weight matches theoretical within ±1 Da.

tests.title: Sterility & mycoplasma
tests.body: 14-day sterility (USP <71>) and mycoplasma qPCR on every lot.

items.title: EU-GMP vendors
items.body: We audit every peptide manufacturer annually, on-site, in person.

items.title: ISO 17025 testing
items.body: Independent labs in DE, FI, and NL re-test every batch before it ships.

items.title: EU-wide logistics
items.body: Helsinki → you, in 24h. Tracked, signed-for, ambient or cold-chain as needed.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping, returns & guarantees

items.title: Carriers
items.body: Posti (FI primary), DHL Express (rest of EU), DPD Classic.

items.title: Dispatch
items.body: Orders placed before 14:00 EET ship same business day. Others ship within 24h.

items.title: Cold-chain
items.body: Ambient-stable peptides ship at room temp in protective foam. Refrigerated items ship with cold packs.

items.title: Returns
items.body: Unopened product returnable within 14 days. Opened / temperature-compromised vials not returnable.

shippingReturns.freeShippingNote: Free shipping on EU orders over €150.
shippingReturns.guaranteeSub: If your order never arrived or was held by customs on a verified carrier error, we make it right.
shippingReturns.guaranteeDidntArriveBody: If tracking shows the parcel lost in transit or never delivered, contact support with your order number. We open a carrier investigation and reship the same products free of charge as soon as the investigation concludes.
shippingReturns.guaranteeCustomsBody: Research-use peptides sold by AverianLabs are not controlled substances and clear EU customs routinely. If a parcel is held and the cause is verified to be on the carrier or our dispatch paperwork, we reship at no cost.
shippingReturns.guaranteeReshipFailsBody: We refund the full cost of the affected products — including original shipping — once the second delivery fails to land within the carrier's stated ETA.
shippingReturns.supportSub: Most product-selection and reconstitution questions are answered in seconds by Averia, our trained research concierge. Complex or commercial enquiries route to our Helsinki team.
shippingReturns.supportAveriaBody: Trained on every product datasheet, COA, and reconstitution guide. Asks for the order number when needed and never hallucinates purity numbers.
shippingReturns.supportHumanBody: Helsinki-based lab specialists. Email support@averianlabs.eu — typical response within 1 business day; priority queue for wholesale and academic orders.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing averianlabs.eu or any affiliated domain, you agree to these Terms of Service. All products are sold under a strict research-use-only license.

eligibility.title: 1. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be 18 years or older and a qualified researcher or institutional buyer to purchase from AverianLabs.

researchUse.title: 2. Research use only
researchUse.body: All products are intended strictly for laboratory research and in-vitro studies. They are NOT intended for human consumption, diagnostic use, or therapeutic applications.

pricing.title: 3. Pricing & VAT
pricing.body: Prices are inclusive of EU VAT (OSS scheme). B2B customers with a valid VAT ID may purchase reverse-charge at checkout.

shipping.title: 4. Shipping
shipping.body: We dispatch within 24 hours from our Helsinki warehouse. Risk of loss passes to the buyer upon carrier scan.

returns.title: 5. Returns
returns.body: Due to the nature of research-grade peptides, opened or temperature-compromised vials are not returnable. Unopened product may be returned within 14 days for exchange or refund.

liability.title: 6. Liability
liability.body: AverianLabs' liability is limited to the purchase price of the product. We do not warrant fitness for any particular research application beyond the published Certificate of Analysis.

governingLaw.title: 7. Governing law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by Finnish law. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Helsinki District Court.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how AverianLabs Oy ("we") processes personal data on averianlabs.eu and affiliated domains, in compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Personal Data Act.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: Account data: email, name, hashed password (if you create an account). Order data: shipping/billing address, order history. Technical data: IP (truncated), user agent, referrer (kept 30 days). Analytics: only with your explicit consent via the cookie banner.

lawfulBasis.title: Lawful basis
lawfulBasis.body: Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) for orders, consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) for analytics, legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) for accounting.

subprocessors.title: Subprocessors
subprocessors.body: Stripe Payments Europe Ltd — payment processing (EU); Coinbase Commerce — crypto payments; Resend — transactional email (EU); PostHog Cloud EU — product analytics (consent-gated); Sanity Inc. — content (US, EU data residency); Cloudflare — CDN / DDoS; Neon — database (Frankfurt).

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object. Email privacy@averianlabs.eu. You may also lodge a complaint with your national supervisory authority (in Finland: tietosuojavaltuutettu).

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Account data: until deletion. Order data: 7 years (accounting). Analytics: 14 months.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Data Protection Officer: dpo@averianlabs.eu · AverianLabs Oy, Helsinki, Finland.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: We use a minimal set of cookies. Essential cookies cannot be disabled; analytics cookies require your consent.

essential.title: Essential
essential.body: averianlabs-cart — saves your cart (1 year); averianlabs-age-confirmed — remembers age-gate confirmation (1 year); averianlabs-cookie-consent — remembers your cookie choice (1 year); Stripe / Coinbase session cookies (set by payment provider).

analytics.title: Analytics (consent)
analytics.body: PostHog (EU) and Plausible are loaded only after you click "Accept all" on the cookie banner. They collect anonymised, aggregated usage data.

changeChoice.title: Change your choice
changeChoice.body: Click the small "Cookies" link in the footer, or clear your browser data.

notForHuman.title: Not for human consumption
notForHuman.body: The products listed on averianlabs.eu are not intended for human or veterinary use, consumption, administration, or application to the body in any form.

noMedicalClaims.title: No medical claims
noMedicalClaims.body: Information provided on this website is for research and educational purposes only. It is not intended as medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation. AverianLabs Oy does not endorse, recommend, or support the off-label use of any product.

buyerResponsibility.body: By purchasing from AverianLabs, you confirm that you are a qualified researcher or institutional buyer, and that the products will be used solely for legitimate laboratory research in compliance with all applicable local, national, and international laws and regulations.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.body: It is the buyer's responsibility to ensure that the import, possession, and use of research peptides complies with all applicable regulations in their jurisdiction. AverianLabs Oy reserves the right to refuse service to any buyer or jurisdiction at its sole discretion.
